metadata.note: Cast 4-into-1 manifold (outer runners longer) into the Garrett T3 turbine (0.48 A/R housing), represented by its throat (26 mm, 0.08 m); the closed wastegate is not represented; one pipe through the centre and rear silencers to one tailpipe. Every pipe is an estimate. Silencer, catalyst and collector-box bodies are straight pipes of their inlet diameter. Valve: 36.5 mm (FIA A-5355); 9.5 mm lift and about 238 deg are estimates.
